SDAR1.label: Access reports

SDAR1.1.label: View access reports
SDAR1.1.description: Definition: Use when the customer requests or cannot view reports about available access or entitlements.

SDAR1.2.label: View usage reports
SDAR1.2.description: Definition: Use when the customer requests or cannot view usage statistics or other reports.

SDAR1.3.label: Not enough info
SDAR1.3.description: Definition: Use when a reporting issue is mentioned without identifying the report type.

SDAR1.4.label: Other
SDAR1.4.description: Definition: Use for another access-reporting issue not listed above.

SDAR1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified as 'Access reports'. Choose the root cause from this group only. That contact reason means: Use when the customer needs, cannot retrieve or questions usage or access reporting data, with signals such as COUNTER reports, usage statistics, report exports or the Admin Tool, and not when they cannot access articles.
